newsitem.title: USA: CoCensys files for Phase II test of drug.
newsitem.headline: CoCensys files for Phase II test of drug.

text.p: CoCensys Inc said on Monday it will soon file for a Phase II trial of its neuroactive steroid (epalon) compound, called CCD 1042, for use in patients with migraine headaches.
Results of the double-blind, placebo-controlled tests, will be designed to study the efficacy of the drug, CoCensys said in a statement.
In animal studies at Massachusetts General Hospital, naturally occurring epalons suppressed brain lining inflammation, which is believed to be a cause of migraines, CoCensys said.
At the Hambrecht & Quist health care conference in San Francisco, a CoCensys executive said the company expects to file its investigational new drug application for CCD 1042 in February.
